download.label: download
download.title: Getting CoreFX
steps: 1. Make a free account on our Patreon. Both **Singleplayer** builds — Legacy and Enhanced — are available at no cost once you join with a free membership. The **Legacy FiveM** build is on the $5 tier.
2. Subscribe to the CoreFX page and open any post announcing a CoreFX update to reveal the latest download links. The $9 tier gets new updates 10 days before everyone else.
3. Download the archive and follow the CoreFX setup instructions for your platform in the [CoreFX documentation](/docs/prerequisites).
download.support: **Supporting us:** a paid [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/crxhvrd/membership) tier adds the FiveM build and early access to updates. No visual effect is locked behind it; it helps us keep working on CoreFX.
download.licence: Every archive ships with the CoreFX [end user licence](/license). Installing CoreFX means accepting it.

banner.text: This site is also available in English.
